page.overview:
Who is Rewancha?

Rewancha is a very large man with a stern, grumpy face and stout, muscular frame. He dresses in warrior robes likely native to his country of Nayshall (although they more closely Chinese clothing in origin). The robes are assymetrical, with the left side possessing a fur-lined folded collar and a long sleeve with a fur cuff.

Rewancha appears as a recurring NPC in the Street Fighter 6's World Tour mode.

Both Kalima and Rewancha are high-ranking members of the Nayshall Resistance. While their exact relationship is unknown, Rewancha seems to take a subordinate ranking to Kalima, and he usually acts as a guard or partner to watch her back.

As another member of the Resistance, Bosch and Rewancha know each other, as they work together to fulfill the Resistance's goals. Rewancha fights the Avatar to uphold Bosch's wishes, at least indicating some mutual respect.
